TRACE of Matrices:
 The trace of a square matrix A, denoted as tr(A), is the sum of the elements on the main diagonal (from the top left to the bottom right).

 If A = [a11 a12]
 [a21 a22]

 Then, tr(A) = a11 + a22

 Consider a 3x3 matrix A = [a11 a12 a13]
 [a21 a22 a23]
 [a31 a32 a33].

 The trace is: tr(A)= a11 + a22 + a33
